name: Moonglade
summary: Your teacher opens a way to Moonglade, where Dendrite Starblaze awaits. There, you can speak with him about the path you have begun.

sections.title: A First Lesson
sections.body: Your teacher welcomes druids to Moonglade. Keeper Remulos watches over those who rest there. You receive Teleport: Moonglade, a spell that carries you there when you seek knowledge or solace. Your first lesson is to speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you now follow.

sections.title: The Bear Form
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze recognizes that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. He sees you well on your way.

faq.q: Who should I speak to in Moonglade?
faq.answer: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you are on.

faq.q: How do I get to Moonglade?
faq.answer: Your teacher gives you Teleport: Moonglade, a spell that carries you there.

faq.q: Who watches over druids in Moonglade?
faq.answer: Keeper Remulos watches over druids who rest in Moonglade.

faq.q: What does Dendrite say about my progress?
faq.answer: Dendrite recognizes that you have already mastered the form of the Bear.

angles.text: As a druid, your teacher welcomes you to Moonglade and teaches you a spell to travel there.
